summary: Completed frontend testing of Home page toggle functionality (Lato Pubblico ↔ Lato Segreto). Card image crossfade, atmosphere overlay, hero text changes, and analytics tracking are all working correctly. Toggle is properly hidden/shown based on viewport size. No page reload, no scroll jump, no horizontal overflow on any device. CRITICAL ISSUE: All FilmStrip videos (both public and secret) fail to load due to corrupted/invalid video files - browser reports 'FFmpegDemuxer: no supported streams'. However, poster images display correctly as fallback, so no black videos appear.

critical_bugs.issue: All video files (pub1.mp4, pub2.mp4, pub3.mp4, sec1.mp4, sec2.mp4, sec3.mp4, sec4.mp4) fail to load with error: 'PipelineStatus::DEMUXER_ERROR_NO_SUPPORTED_STREAMS: FFmpegDemuxer: no supported streams'
critical_bugs.root_cause: Video files are corrupted or improperly encoded - browser cannot find valid video/audio streams
critical_bugs.impact: Videos do not play in FilmStrip section. Poster images display as fallback, so no black frames appear, but the intended video playback functionality is broken
critical_bugs.fix_required: Re-encode or replace all video files in /app/frontend/public/media/ with valid MP4 files (H.264 video codec, AAC audio codec recommended for browser compatibility)
critical_bugs.verification: Files exist and are downloadable via curl, but browser FFmpeg demuxer cannot parse them. Error occurs in both PUBLIC and SECRET modes after 5+ seconds of load time.

passed_tests: Desktop (1920x1080): Toggle button found and functional
Toggle text changes correctly: 'LATO PUBBLICO' ↔ 'LATO SEGRETO'
Hero text changes when toggling modes
Card image crossfade working perfectly: public image (opacity 1→0) and secret image (opacity 0→1) with 600ms transition
Different images used for public vs secret modes (verified via DOM inspection)
Atmosphere overlay appears with full opacity in secret mode (warmer bordeaux/purple gradient)
No page reload when toggling (URL remains unchanged)
Analytics events tracked correctly: 'home_toggle_secret_on' and 'home_toggle_secret_off' sent to POST /api/track
No scroll jump when toggling mid-page (24px difference is within acceptable range)
Tablet (640x844): Toggle button visible and functional
Tablet: No horizontal overflow in either mode
Tablet: Card click navigates to profile page correctly
Mobile (390x844): Toggle button properly hidden (as expected per design)
Mobile: FilmStrip section present and doesn't cause page overflow
FilmStrip poster images display correctly as fallback (no black frames)
FilmStrip animation/marquee continues smoothly in both modes
action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Replace all video files in /app/frontend/public/media/ with properly encoded MP4 files. Current files are corrupted/invalid and cannot be played by browser (FFmpegDemuxer error: no supported streams). Recommended encoding: H.264 video codec, AAC audio codec, MP4 container. All other toggle functionality is working perfectly - this is purely a media file issue.
